title: Two System Awareness
definition: The ability to effectively work across local and cloud systems, understanding their differences and utilizing them appropriately.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Working efficiently on both local and cloud systems, knowing which tasks belong where.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Awareness of the differences between local and cloud computing environments and the ability to choose the optimal one for each task.
difficulty_levels.expert: Understanding the unique capabilities and constraints of both local and cloud systems, and using this knowledge to optimize workflows, improve performance, and maintain data security.

extra_fields.insight: The importance of recognizing the strengths and weaknesses of local and cloud systems, and leveraging them strategically.
